properties.label_en: Garama / Jarmah (Garamantian chief town, reference marker)
properties.label_detail_en: Garama (Jerma) chief town of the Garamantes, 'the only organized state' of the Saharan interior, dominating the Fezzan; client of Rome after +69; about ten centuries to the Arabs (GHA II ch.20 p.522). Routes from Garama east to the Nile (p.526). Coordinates: Wikidata Q10306391 (modern Jarmah). Open edges: no limit line in the source; not a border.
